environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in isolated private subnets (no NAT, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 PrivateLink endpoint service. Consumer VPC endpoints are restricted via endpoint policy allowing only principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalCallerRole. The ENIs backing the VPC endpoint have security group sg-0xdeadbeef which permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (internal service mesh subnet). There is no public hosted zone, no internet gateway, and no peering to any VPC with internet egress. Route tables for the Fargate subnets contain only local routes and the VPC endpoint prefix list. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network-related permissions and the task definition sets readonlyRootFilesystem: true. Spring profile 'production' is active but does NOT disable the /debug/encrypt endpoint at the application level.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnets (no IGW, no NAT)
config.load_balancer: none (NLB target for PrivateLink endpoint service)
